Hero.description: In surveying, registration and mapping processes built on engineering discipline; we deliver clarity, confidence and verifiable results.

l1.title: Stakeout (Boundary Determination)
l1.description: Precise determination and marking of parcel boundaries on site.

l2.title: Land Use Change Registration
l2.description: Updating your property classification in the title deed records (built/unbuilt).

l3.title: Easement Right Establishment
l3.description: Establishing usage rights such as right of way, water source or superficies.

l4.title: Parcel Consolidation (Tevhid)
l4.description: Technical consolidation of adjacent parcels into a single parcel.

l5.title: On-Site Parcel Location
l5.description: Showing the location of your parcel on the ground based on cadastral maps.

e1.title: As-Built / Base Map Production
e1.description: Mapping current site conditions, structures and details onto up-to-date maps.

e2.title: Zoning Applications
e2.description: Article 18 implementations to transform raw land into planned parcels.

e3.title: Topographic Survey (Plankote)
e3.description: Technical surveying with elevation and slope details for architectural projects.

e4.title: Construction Surveys & Volume Calculations
e4.description: Accurate construction surveys for excavation/fill and stakeout workflows.

e5.title: Drone (UAV) Mapping
e5.description: High-resolution aerial mapping of large areas with photogrammetric methods.
